shared_elements: carved stone with a human-like figure
headdress/headgear covering the top of the head
small circular/disc motifs (chest disc in A; rows of beads and rosette-like circles in B)
justification: Both are large single blocks of stone bearing an anthropomorphic figure whose head is capped by an elaborate banded headdress, with incised linear bands and small circular motifs decorating the body/chest area. Beyond that generic correspondence they diverge sharply: A is a heavily eroded, volumetric frontal statue with blunt, shallow schematic incision on dark rough stone, while B is a crisply cut, finely detailed low relief in pale limestone showing a head in strict profile with dense, controlled ornamental texture.
